payload.body: You tend to sound measured while someone else says the thing you were already thinking. Then you often argue with their tone, their timing, or the certainty of the point even when part of you agrees. This often happens when direct speech was treated as rude, risky, or disloyal, so the uncensored side of the conversation gets assigned to another person. State your own position before debating how they stated theirs.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite Mercury can split your thinking between the acceptable answer and the sharper point you actually believe.
